newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Santos port dispute talks reset for May 27.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Santos port dispute talks reset for May 27.

text.p: Talks on a labor dispute scheduled today between union representatives from Brazil's port of Santos and local steel firm Cosipa were postponed until May 27, a Cosipa spokeswoman said.
"One of the union representatives did not show up so it was decided to postpone the meeting until May 27," she said.
The representative was from one of the smaller unions involved in the talks, she added.
Union members last month staged two strikes at the port in protest at Cosipa's decision to use its own workers to load and unload at its private terminal.

However a series of meetings and a proposal by union leaders which would cut total costs for Cosipa by 60 percent has virtually removed any further chance of a strike, an official from the local stevedores' union said earlier today.
